network.name: Acme ERP Change Network
network.purpose: Embed trusted voices in every impacted team to translate program information, surface concerns, advocate for the change, and support colleagues through training and go-live.
network.sizing_basis: ~1 champion per 25 impacted employees; every impacted team/site has at least one champion.

tiers.role: Visible authorization: launches the network, recognizes contribution, unblocks nomination stalls.

tiers.who: One per business unit, manager level
tiers.role: Coordinates the champions in their BU; first escalation point; attends the lead-level cadence.

tiers.who: Frontline peers embedded in each impacted team/site
tiers.role: Cascade messages, collect feedback, flag resistance early, support adoption locally.
tiers.time_commitment: 10-15% of working time, varying by phase

selection_criteria: Works in the affected area and is personally impacted
Trusted, credible peer — influence over seniority
Has capacity; manager informed and supportive
Constructive engagement — skeptics welcome, active detractors are not

time_by_phase.activities: Training reinforcement, floor support, daily check-ins
Issue surfacing, adoption support, peer coaching

recognition: Named acknowledgment in sponsor communications at milestones
Champion network introduced to the broader organization at comms ramp-up
Go-live recognition event for the full network

workflow: OCM defines selection criteria and the seat map (which groups need a champion)
Leadership nominates by deadline via the nomination email + pre-filled workbook
OCM screens nominees against criteria; confirms willingness and manager support
Onboarding session held; seat status moves to Onboarded

cadence.name: Change Network Briefing
cadence.purpose: Program updates, key messages, talking points, one clear ask, round robin, Q&A

cadence.name: OCM Office Hours
cadence.purpose: Open session for questions, feedback, and challenges

cadence.name: Feedback Pulse
cadence.purpose: Quick survey: what is your team saying and feeling?

cadence.name: Change Lead Sync
cadence.purpose: Coverage review, escalations, next briefing's ask

cadence.name: Sponsor Touchpoint
cadence.purpose: Recognition, network health review, expectation reset

cadence.name: Network Resource Site
cadence.purpose: Latest talking points, FAQs, onboarding guide, briefing packs
